dataset.name: MarineCadastre / NOAA AIS vessel traffic, broadcast-point CSV, 2026-01-01
dataset.product: daily CSV (compressed .csv.zst present locally); not the GeoParquet product
dataset.retrieval_date: unknown (local file mtime of .zst: 2026-10-18; organizer-provided subsets)
dataset.subset_rules: Organizer subsets are byte-identical head-prefixes of ais-2026-01-01.csv (verified with cmp); never combined. Region filter: all; deterministic vessel sample of 4000 MMSIs by hash key.
dataset.missing_value_policy: SOG>=102.2 (102.3 sentinel) -> null; COG>=360 -> null; heading>=360 (511) -> null; lat/lon out of range or (0,0) dropped; duplicate (mmsi,timestamp) -> first kept. These are OBSERVED source problems, handled before any injected defects.
dataset.rights_statement: NOAA/BOEM MarineCadastre data are U.S. Government public data; check the product metadata/terms before redistribution. Raw data are not redistributed in this repo (data/ is git-ignored).

task.evaluation_proxy: first later AIS report of the same MMSI within horizon +/- tolerance; a noisy proxy, not verified truth

split.rule: vessel-disjoint (hash(mmsi)%10<3 -> test) AND chronological: train targets end before split_t; test decisions start at split_t + horizon and need >=45 min of vessel history
split.holdout: window 4 (latest period) plus the 'holdout_unseen_bias' defect type not used when designing the countermeasure

model.retraining: trained once on nominal data; NOT retrained during the degradation progression

defect_configuration.progression: SIMULATED degradation progression over 5 real chronological test windows
defect_configuration.lowq_defects: jitter N(0,200 m) on state and previous fix; 25% gross outlier 3-15 km; SOG scaled x0.3-2.5 (25%), missing (15%), raw 102.3 sentinel (10%); COG random (30%), missing (15%), else +N(0,5 deg); heading dropped
defect_configuration.holdout_unseen_bias: constant 1.5 km offset at bearing 60 deg on the delivered fix
defect_configuration.synthetic_msgs_simulated: reliable_msgs * share/(1-share); a simulated volume, not measured

modification_log: Raw CSVs unchanged. Ingest writes cache/parquet (raw values). Cleaning and all injected defects occur in memory; injected defects are labelled per case (columns source, defects, is_stale, is_lowq) and kept separate from observed source problems.

countermeasure.defer_penalty_rule: p90 of nominal unmitigated error, charged per deferred case in policy_cost_km so that abstaining on everything cannot win

ai_disclosure: Code, documentation and experiment design were generated by Claude (Anthropic, model claude-opus-5-5) via Claude Code following info/CLAUDE_INSTRUCTIONS.md; the AI component under test is the sklearn model, not the LLM.
